Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: TIMED LIFE: PASSIVE Remove this Unit at the End of the Round.
STRUCTURE: PASSIVE This Unit cannot be Activated in any Phase and cannot perform actions. Additionally, its Current
Supply Value is treated as 0 , and it can never Control or Contest Mission Markers , ignoring the standard Zero Supply
Exception . This Unit cannot be a target of an ability, unless stated otherwise.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: OVERWATCH: REACTION 0 CP Use when an Enemy Unit ends its Activation Within 8" of this Unit. This Unit
immediately performs a Ranged Attack against that Enemy Unit.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: TARGET LOCK: ACTIVE 1 CP Select one Enemy Unit Within 12" . Whenever
a Friendly Goliath Unit targets that enemy with an Autocannon , that weapon gains Surge Type: Light,
Armoured , and S Dice: D3+1 .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: INDOMITABLE: PASSIVE While Engaged , this Unit
may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy
Units. In both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade
Roll against those attacks.
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (4) 3+ effect.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: TIMED LIFE: PASSIVE Remove this Unit at
the End of the Round .
DECOY: PASSIVE This Unit is never Engaged . It cannot
Engage Enemy Units, cannot be Engaged by Enemy Units
and cannot perform a Charge Action . This Unit cannot
be the target of an ability, unless stated otherwise. It can
never Control or Contest Mission Markers .
SURPRISE!: PASSIVE At the End of the Round , you can set
a Friendly Nova Stealth Mode or Nova Assault Mode in
Coherency with this Unit.
LETHAL HOLOGRAM : PASSIVE All Weapons of Friendly
Units targeting an Enemy Unit Within 4" of this Unit gain
PRECISION (1) .

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: COMMANDER: PASSIVE Treat this Unit's
Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and
Contesting Mission Markers , completing objectives, and
resolving Disengage checks.
FREEDOM FIGHTERS: PASSIVE The Supply Value of all
Friendly Units Within 8" of this Unit cannot be reduced
below 1 for Contesting Mission Markers and completing
objectives.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: ORDERS: ACTIVE X CP REPEATABLE . Select another Friendly Biological Unit Within
8" , spend CP and apply one of the following effects:
1 CP : That Unit's first used weapon gains the CRITICAL HIT (2) .
1 CP : That Unit ignores the Disengage penalty for the remainder of the Round.
2 CP : Remove the Activation Marker from that Unit.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: STIMPACK: ACTIVE 1 CP This Unit suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (2) . This Unit gains
BUFF Speed (3) . Additionally, its Quad K12 and all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (2) .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: CONCUSIVE SHELLS: REACTION 1 CP When an Enemy declares a Charge against a Friendly Unit Within 8" , that
Enemy gains DEBUFF Speed (2) .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: STIMPACK: ACTIVE 1 CP This Unit suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (2) . This Unit
gains BUFF Speed (3) . Additionally, its C-14 Rifle and all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (3) .

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: LIFE SUPPORT: REACTION 1 CP Use when
another Friendly Biological Unit suffers Damage Within
4" . Reduce the Total Damage before allocation by 1 for
each model in this Unit that is Within 4" of the damaged
Unit.
RESTORATION: REACTION 1 CP Use when a Friendly Unit
Within 4" receives a DEBUFF . Remove all DEBUFFS from it.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: MEDPACK: ACTIVE
1 CP Select another Friendly Biological Unit Within
4" . Resolve the HEAL (X) effect for the targeted Unit,
where X is the number of models in this Unit that are
Within 4" of the target Unit.
OPTICAL FLARE: ACTIVE 2 CP Select one Enemy Unit
Within 12" . Until the End of the Round , apply DEBUFF
Range (4) to that Unit's Ranged Weapons . That Unit
cannot benefit from LONG RANGE.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: BATTLE PREPARATION : PASSIVE During
Army Building , your army cannot include both the Nova
Assault Mode Unit and the Nova Stealth Mode Unit.
GHOST VISOR: PASSIVE While Enemy Units are Within 6"
of this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: SUPER STIMPACK:
ACTIVE 1 CP This Unit gains BUFF Speed (2) .
Additionally, all its Weapons gain PRECISION (2).
HOLO DECOY: ACTIVE 1 CP Resolve the SUMMON
(Holo Decoy) effect. Then, Holo Decoy may
immediately perform a Move action.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: PHASE REACTOR SUIT : ACTIVE 1 CP If Unengaged ,
resolve the PLACE (6) effect.
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (4) 4+ effect.

Description:

Assault Mode Unit and the Nova Stealth Mode Unit.

resolves an Action , it gains the HIDDEN Status .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY : PASSIVE After this Unit
fully resolves a Ranged Attack with its C-20A Canister
Rifle , if the target Enemy Unit was Destroyed or its
Current Supply Value was reduced, the active player
may return one of their Exhausted non-Unique
Tactical Cards to its Ready state.
HEAD SHOT: REACTION 1 CP Once Per Game. While
this Unit is Unengaged and has the Stationary Status ,
when it makes a Ranged Attack with its C-20A Canister
Rifle , treat that weapon's Damage characteristic as 3 ,
and it gains CONCENTRATED FIRE (1) .

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: POINT DEFENSE LASER: PASSIVE When
another Friendly Unit Within 4" is targeted by a Ranged
Attack without the INSTANT keyword, remove up to 2
dice from the Attack Pool . Then remove this Unit from the
battlefield.
GLIDING: PASSIVE This model has DISPLACEMENT .
STRUCTURE: PASSIVE This Unit cannot be Activated
in any Phase and cannot perform actions. Additionally,
its Current Supply Value is treated as 0 , and it can
never Control or Contest Mission Markers , ignoring the
standard Zero Supply Exception . This Unit cannot be a
target of an ability, unless stated otherwise.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: DETECTION: PASSIVE While Enemy Units are Within 6" of this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: DEPLOY AUTO-TURRET:
ACTIVE 1 CP Set a Friendly Auto-Turret Unit Within
6" , and not Within the Engagement Range of any
Enemy Unit.
ANTI-ARMOUR MISSILE: ACTIVE 1 CP Select one
Enemy Unit Within 12" . Apply DEBUFF Armour (1) .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: STIMPACK: ACTIVE 1 CP
This Unit suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (2) . This Unit
gains BUFF Speed (3) . Additionally, its C-14 Rifle and
all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (3) .
RAIDERS ROLL!: PASSIVE When this Unit is nominated
to deploy from Reserves , it may resolve its Stimpack
ability with the CP cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum
of 0).
RAPID REINFORCEMENTS: PASSIVE When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves , it may resolve the
PLACE (10) effect from another Friendly Unit. No model may be set Within 8" of any Enemy model. This Unit's
Activation ends.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: SLUGTHROWER: PASSIVE When this Unit makes
a Ranged Attack with a C-14 Rifle and the target is
Within 8" , that weapon gains ANTI-EVADE (1) .
GRENADES - FRAG: PASSIVE When this Unit makes
a Ranged Attack with a C-14 Rifle and the target is
Within 8" , that weapon's S Dice is replaced by D6 .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: HAVE A NICE DAY: PASSIVE At the End of the Assault Phase , target each Unit Within
3" of this Unit (including Units with the Structure ability) suffers HITS 5 (1) . If an affected Unit has the Structure
ability, that Unit suffers an additional HITS 5 (1) .

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: LARGE: PASSIVE When this Unit's Leading
Model moves, it cannot pass through physical gaps smaller
than 3" wide, regardless of its size. If the Leading Model's
path of travel passes through, or any model in this Unit
ends its movement on a Size 0 or Size 1 Impassible Terrain
piece ( excluding Tokens) during any movement action, that
terrain piece is immediately removed from the game.
HEAVY PLATING: PASSIVE When this Unit resolves an
Armour Roll , it gains TOUGH (1) , provided it does not
currently have the SIEGE MODE Status .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: INDOMITABLE: PASSIVE While Engaged , this Unit
may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy
Units. In both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade
Roll against those attacks.
POINT BLANK: PASSIVE While this Unit has the
SIEGE MODE Status , it cannot target Enemy Units it is
Engaged with.
AFTERSHOCK ROUNDS: PASSIVE When this Unit has
the SIEGE MODE Status , its Damage characteristic is
treated as equal to the Size characteristic of the current
target Unit (to a minimum of 1) .
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (4) 3+ effect.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: SPEC OPS ARMOUR: ACTIVE 1 CP This Unit gains the HIDDEN Status until it performs another action.

its Quad K12 and all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (2) .

Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: MAGRAIL MUNITIONS: PASSIVE This Unit's first
Attack in the game with its Quad K12 gains PIERCE
Armoured (3) .
SUPPRESSION SHELLS: REACTION 1 CP When an
Enemy declares a Charge against a Friendly Unit
Within 8" , that Enemy gains DEBUFF Speed (3) .
